productConcept.name: Prismatica Instruments
productConcept.description: Precision spectrographic analysis equipment — diffraction-grating spectrometers and optical analysis systems for materials science, atmospheric monitoring, and quantum research laboratories.
productConcept.rationale: The iron-pulse design system's near-black palette with iridescent prismatic accents (blue #4a9eff, teal #00d4aa, orange #ff6b35) maps precisely to the chromatic dispersion of light through a diffraction grating — the core optical component of a spectrometer. The 3D logo mark in the source with holographic color accents reads as a grating surface. Inter weight-800 headlines suit a precision instrument manufacturer where authority and legibility signal credibility. Cormorant Garamond provides editorial depth for scientific narrative. The masonry grid aesthetic maps cleanly to a portfolio of instruments displayed as a product catalogue. The concept avoids all 11 prohibited product concepts and chooses a product world (scientific instrumentation) that is entirely absent from the prior list.
